title: Candidate shared-phreatic coupling contract for SWAP5-MODFLOW6

real_swap_audits: GC-REAL-SWAP-MAP12 legacy GWL versus lower-face-head semantics
external_reference: Van Walsum and Veldhuizen (2011) shared-state SIMGRO concept
Deltares imod_coupler current MetaSWAP-MODFLOW6 storage/head mapping at commit 8907fb13f8301ba1e0f32dd90a64ea475d4896d6

scope: Define a mathematically testable alternative coupling family. Do not replace or modify the admitted current mode-5 interface-head F-GC route.

state_contract.shared_state: H_phreatic, one physical water-table hydraulic head per coupled groundwater cell
state_contract.swap_internal_state: All unsaturated/process memory xi_swap remains SWAP-owned and is not reconstructed from H_phreatic alone.
state_contract.modflow_internal_state: Regional saturated-flow state and lateral-flow degrees of freedom remain MODFLOW-owned.
state_contract.distinction: H_phreatic is not H_interface unless a separately proven geometric/hydraulic mapping makes them identical.

geometric_contract.required: For every coupled cell, declare which vertical physical volume is represented by SWAP complete-profile storage and which MODFLOW layers/storage volumes overlap or lie outside it.
geometric_contract.overlap_rule: Any physical storage volume represented by the SWAP complete-profile H_phreatic response must not simultaneously retain an independent MODFLOW Sy/Ss storage contribution.
geometric_contract.complement_rule: MODFLOW storage outside the SWAP-owned complete-profile volume may remain active if its physical volume is disjoint and explicitly documented.
geometric_contract.moving_phreatic_layer: If H_phreatic crosses MODFLOW layers, the storage/recharge/head mapping must move to the currently phreatic layer or use another independently derived equivalent representation.

swap_trial_contract.required_new_semantic_owner: A typed prescribed-groundwater-level / phreatic-state trial, scientifically reconciled to legacy SWBOTB=1 lineage or independently derived. Current bottom_mode=5 is not sufficient authority.
swap_trial_contract.immutable_origin: Every nonlinear coupling trial starts from the same accepted SWAP origin for the window.
outputs: complete-profile storage change DeltaV_swap(H_phreatic; xi0, forcing)
all non-groundwater external process amounts over the window
a storage response suitable for the groundwater solve, with provenance and time-window support
swap_trial_contract.not_authoritative_in_hlink: Current mode-5 bottom-interface exchange must not automatically be added as an independent whole-system transfer if it is internal to the declared coextensive shared-phreatic domain.

groundwater_contract.role: Solve regional/lateral saturated groundwater flow for H_phreatic using the SWAP-owned coupled phreatic storage response and process remainder.
groundwater_contract.storage_rule: For the coextensive phreatic storage volume, MODFLOW STO must use the SWAP-derived storage response or an exactly equivalent partition whose sum equals the one physical response.
groundwater_contract.lateral_flow: MODFLOW retains ownership of lateral/boundary groundwater-flow contributions.
groundwater_contract.head_return: Accepted/trial MODFLOW H_phreatic is the shared state supplied to the SWAP phreatic trial.

nonlinear_balance.exact_conceptual_residual: F(H)=DeltaV_profile(H;xi0,forcing) - V_process_net_in(H;xi0,forcing) - V_groundwater_lateral_net_in(H) = 0, with one sign convention fixed before implementation.
nonlinear_balance.alternative_incremental_form: mu_eff(H_ref)*(H-H_ref) = process_remainder + groundwater_lateral_contribution only as a linearization of the same one-volume balance.
nonlinear_balance.tangent_rule: Storage derivative, process derivatives and groundwater-flow Jacobian must be derived from this residual. Do not infer physical ownership from HCOF units.

storage_response_questions_to_close: Whether the appropriate MODFLOW storage object is an endpoint derivative dDeltaV/dH, a finite-window secant, or another shared-state response for the chosen time discretization.
How MAP10's window-dependent u_A relates to the storage response required by the h-link residual.
How head-dependent ET, drainage and capillary/internal-memory processes enter the residual separately from storage.

multiswap_contract.shared_cell_head: All SWAP tiles mapped to one groundwater cell receive the same H_phreatic trial value.
multiswap_contract.storage_aggregation: Area-weighted physical storage responses are summed once for the groundwater cell.
multiswap_contract.process_aggregation: Area-weighted process remainders/recharge contributions are summed separately from storage.
multiswap_contract.transaction: Each tile keeps independent SWAP lineage, candidate and internal memory; cell publication is atomic across all mapped tiles and groundwater state.

acceptance_contract: lateral-groundwater plus SWAP process balance closure
minimum_research_program: HLINK01: coextensive analytical one-cell reproduction using DSW23 geometry and live MODFLOW storage replacement.
HLINK02: nonlinear storage curve, compare exact integrated storage residual with tangent/iteration formulations.
HLINK03: head-dependent ET/drain/internal-memory decomposition under shared phreatic state.
HLINK04: typed real-SWAP prescribed-GWL trial from immutable origin, initially with no optional processes.
HLINK05: compare real-SWAP H_phreatic storage derivative against current mode-5 finite-window u_A without assuming equality.
HLINK06: N:1 heterogeneous tiles to one MODFLOW cell with area-weighted storage/process ownership.
HLINK07: moving phreatic layer across MODFLOW vertical layers.
HLINK08: lateral MODFLOW forcing only and mixed atmospheric/lateral forcing.
HLINK09: q-link finite-resistance convergence to h-link limit with identical physical domain declaration.
HLINK10: restart, rejected-trial and mass-ledger qualification.

coexistence_with_current_fgc.current_route: Keep admitted mode-5 interface-head/bottom-exchange F-GC unchanged during research.
coexistence_with_current_fgc.comparison_goal: Determine for which physical domain decompositions the boundary-head route and shared-phreatic route are each appropriate and whether they converge in controlled limits.

forbidden: no production source changes from this design
do not disable MODFLOW STO globally
do not reuse current u as phreatic Sy without a new residual/storage derivation
do not relabel bottom_mode=5 as a groundwater-level state
do not infer MetaSWAP numerical choices are automatically correct for SWAP5
